ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a square, with the side length marked at the top as 6 cm. A dashed line passes horizontally through the middle of the square, and is an axis of symmetry. Point A and point B are located on this horizontal dashed line. The gray shaded region is a quadrilateral, whose vertices in order can be regarded as the lower-left corner of the square, point A, the upper-right corner of the square, and point B; the other two remaining white regions are unshaded regions. Reasoning: Establish a coordinate system according to the specified method, let the four vertices of the square be (0,0), (6,0), (6,6), (0,6), and the horizontal axis of symmetry be y=3. Suppose A=(a,3), B=(b,3), then AB=b-a. The vertices of the shaded quadrilateral in order are (0,0), (a,3), (6,6), (b,3). Use the shoelace formula to find the area: Area = 1/2 |(0·3 + a·6 + 6·3 + b·0) - (0·a + 3·6 + 6·b + 3·0)| = 1/2 |6a+18-18-6b| = 3(b-a) = 3AB. The area of the square is 6×6=36 cm². The shaded area is equal to each of the two unshaded areas, so the areas of the three regions are equal, and each area is 36/3=12 cm². Therefore 3AB=12, obtaining AB=4 cm.

method.method_draft: Use a coordinate-area computation for the shaded quadrilateral. From the image, take the square as having corners (0,0), (6,0), (6,6), and (0,6), with the dashed horizontal symmetry axis at y=3. The shaded region has vertices, in order, bottom-left corner (0,0), A=(a,3), top-right corner (6,6), and B=(b,3). From the text, the shaded area equals each of the two unshaded areas, so the three regions split the 6 by 6 square equally; each has area 36/3=12. Apply the shoelace formula to the shaded quadrilateral: its area is 3(b-a). Since b-a is exactly AB, solve 3AB=12 to get AB=4 cm.

推理：按指定方法建立坐标系，令正方形四个顶点为 (0,0)、(6,0)、(6,6)、(0,6)，水平对称轴为 y=3。设 A=(a,3)，B=(b,3)，则 AB=b-a。阴影四边形顶点依次为 (0,0)、(a,3)、(6,6)、(b,3)。用鞋带公式求面积：
面积 = 1/2 |(0·3 + a·6 + 6·3 + b·0) - (0·a + 3·6 + 6·b + 3·0)|
